name: The Legend of Fei
source:
In the enchanted forest of Deldelia, the Corvani – a birdlike race descended from crows, ravens, magpies, and bluejays – undergo the annual Sacrament of Ennoblement. 

Fei, a determined young Corvani, ventures into the forest with his closest friend, facing ancient rituals, strange forces, and tests of courage that will shape his destiny.

[From [url=https://wisteria-arrowdale.itch.io/the-legend-of-fei]Itch.io[/url]]
